validation.noProfile: Select at least one validation profile.

rules.epigraphMissingQuote: An epigraph should contain a quotation.
rules.epigraphSingleQuote: An epigraph should contain only one quotation.
rules.figureContentRestrictedBlock: A figure block may only contain the image, the head and the credits (block `.{{class}}` is not allowed).
rules.figureContentRestrictedText: A figure block may only contain the image, the head and the credits (free text is not allowed).
rules.figureCreditsSpanOrDiv: Figure credits must be provided either inline or as a block, but not both at once.
rules.figureCreditsSpanPlacement: Inline figure credits must be placed in the head or in the image caption.
rules.figureMustContainImage: A figure block must contain an image `![caption](url)`.
rules.figureSingleCredits: A figure may only have one credit.
rules.headingFirstLevel: The first heading must be level 2 (`##`), not level {{level}}.
rules.headingLevel1: Level 1 headings (`#`) are not allowed: the article title is set in the metadata.
rules.headingLevelSkipped: A level {{level}} heading cannot follow a level {{previous}} heading: heading levels must not skip a level.
rules.indexEntryRequiresIdref: An index entry must have an `idref` attribute.
rules.liminaryContentRestricted: A `{{block}}` block may only contain text, quotations, tables, lists and figures (block `.{{class}}` is not allowed).
rules.metadataMissingAuthor: No author is set in the metadata.
rules.metadataMissingAuthorSurname: The last name of author #{{position}} is not set in the metadata.
rules.metadataMissingLang: The document language is not set in the metadata.
rules.metadataMissingPublicationDate: The publication date is not set in the metadata.
rules.metadataMissingTitle: The title is not set in the metadata.
rules.prenoteRequiresOrigin: A prenote block must have an `origin` attribute (aut, pbl or tr).
rules.questionAnswerSpeakerMissing: A `{{block}}` block must include a speaker `[name]{.speaker}`.
rules.questionAnswerSpeakerNotFirst: The speaker must be declared at the start of the `{{block}}` block, before the text.
rules.questionAnswerTextOnly: A `{{block}}` block may only contain text (disallowed element: $t({{element}})).
rules.quotedContentRestricted: The quoted text may contain neither headings nor other quotations (disallowed element: $t({{element}})).
rules.richQuoteContentRestricted: Apart from the quoted text, a rich quote may only contain translations, bibliographic references and index entries (disallowed element: $t({{element}})).
rules.richQuoteContentRestrictedBlock: Apart from translations, a rich quote may not contain blocks (block `.{{class}}` is not allowed).
rules.richQuoteMissingQuote: A rich quote must contain the quoted text in a Markdown quotation (`>`).
rules.singleEpigraph: Only one epigraph is allowed per document.
rules.sponsorTextOnly: A sponsor block may only contain text (disallowed element: $t({{element}})).
rules.translationContentRestricted: Apart from the translated text, a translation block may only contain bibliographic references (disallowed element: $t({{element}})).
rules.translationContentRestrictedBlock: A translation block may not contain blocks (block `.{{class}}` is not allowed).
rules.translationMissingQuote: A translation block must contain the translated text in a Markdown quotation (`>`).
rules.translationRequiresLang: A translation block must have a `lang` attribute.
